ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check in the database */

select count(*) into temp from valid_rbc_groups where
 group_id=:valid_rbc_groups.group_id and 
 test_id=:valid_rbc_groups.test_id;

if temp > 0 then
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

/* check in the buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.group_id,' ') != nvl(:valid_rbc_groups.group_id,' ') or
 nvl(:global.test_id,' ') != nvl(:valid_rbc_groups.test_id,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('group_rg0','C05C10',:global.group_id||','
 ||:global.test_id||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('group_rg0','C05C10',:valid_rbc_groups.group_id||','
 ||:valid_rbc_groups.test_id||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('group_rg0','C05C10',:valid_rbc_groups.group_id||','
 ||:valid_rbc_groups.test_id||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;
